svg.title: Application wiring replaces the provider plumbing
svg.desc: ClangdMain explicitly creates the tidy module only when EnableClangTidy is true. Server and ParseInputs retain their existing generic FeatureModules forwarding. Module-set construction and generic forwarding already existed. Check mode no longer forces the tidy module to load when clang-tidy is disabled.
